en: In the shapes considered so far, which in general distinguish themselves as consciousness, self-consciousness, reason, and spirit, religion has indeed also occurred as consciousness of the absolute essence as such, – but only from the standpoint of the consciousness that is conscious of the absolute essence; however, the absolute essence in and for itself has not appeared in those forms, nor has the self-consciousness of spirit.
zh: 在迄今为止的那些形态中——它们一般地区分为意识、自我意识、理性与精神——，宗教作为对绝对本质本身的意识虽然也已经出现过，——但这只是从那个意识到绝对本质的意识的立场出发来看的；而绝对本质自在自为地本身、精神的自我意识，却并没有在那些形态中出现过。

en: Consciousness itself, insofar as it is understanding, already becomes consciousness of the supersensuous, or of the inner of objective determinate being.
But the supersensuous, the eternal, or whatever one may otherwise call it, is self-less; it is only as yet the universal, which is still far removed from being the spirit that knows itself as spirit.
– Then self-consciousness, which has its consummation in the shape of the unhappy consciousness, was only the pain of spirit that wrests itself out again toward objectivity, but does not attain it.
The unity of the single self-consciousness with its unchangeable essence, to which the former brings itself, therefore remains a beyond of the same.

– The immediate determinate being of reason, which for us emerged from that pain, and its peculiar shapes have no religion, because their self-consciousness knows or seeks itself in the immediate present.
zh: 意识本身，只要它是知性，就已经成为对超感性之物、或者说对对象性定在的内在之物的意识。
但超感性之物、永恒者，或者随便人们还怎么称呼它，都是没有自我的；它还只是那个普遍者，而普遍者还远远不是那个把自己作为精神来知道的精神。
——然后，那个在苦恼意识的形态中达到其完成的自我意识，只是精神的那种痛苦：它重新向对象性挣扎而出，却达不到对象性。
所以，单个的自我意识把自己带向的那种与它不变本质的统一，仍然是它自身的一个彼岸。
——理性的直接定在——它对我们来说是从那种痛苦中生出来的——以及理性那些特有的形态，都没有宗教，因为它们这种自我意识在直接的当下中知道自己、或寻找自己。

en: In the ethical world, by contrast, we saw a religion, namely the religion of the underworld; it is the faith in the fearful, unknown night of fate and in the Eumenides of the departed spirit; – the former is pure negativity in the form of universality, the latter is the same in the form of individuality.

In the latter form, the absolute essence is thus indeed the self and something present, just as the self is nothing other than this; but the single self is this single shadow, which has the universality that is fate separated from itself.

It is indeed a shadow, a sublated this-one, and thus a universal self; but that negative meaning has not yet turned over into this positive one, and therefore the sublated self at the same time still immediately signifies this particular, essence-less one.
– But fate without the self remains the unconscious night, which does not arrive at distinction within itself, nor at the clarity of self-knowing.
zh: 反之，在伦理世界中我们看到了一种宗教，即冥府的宗教；它是对命运那可怕而未知的夜晚的信仰，也是对那已离世的精神的复仇女神的信仰；——前者是普遍性形式中的纯粹否定性，后者是个别性形式中的同一个纯粹否定性。
所以，在后一种形式中，绝对本质固然是自我、是当下的东西，正如自我本来就不是别的；但单个的自我只是这个单个的阴影，它把那个作为命运的普遍性与自己分离开来。
它固然是阴影，是被扬弃了的这一个，因而是普遍的自我；但那种否定的意义还没有翻转成这种肯定的意义，所以这个被扬弃的自我同时仍然直接意味着这个特殊的、无本质的东西。
——但离开自我的命运，仍然是那种无意识的夜晚；这种夜晚既达不到在自身之中的区分，也达不到自知的澄明。

en: This faith in the nothingness of necessity and in the underworld becomes faith in heaven, because the departed self must unite itself with its universality, unfold within it what it contains, and thereby become clear to itself.
But we saw this realm of faith only unfold its content in the element of thinking, without the concept, and therefore perish in its fate, namely in the religion of the Enlightenment.

In this, the supersensuous beyond of the understanding re-establishes itself, but in such a way that the self-consciousness stands satisfied on this side and knows the supersensuous – the empty beyond, which is neither to be cognized nor to be feared – neither as a self nor as a power.
zh: 这种对必然性的虚无、对冥府的信仰，变成了对天国的信仰，因为那个已离世的自我必须与它的普遍性结合起来，在普遍性中把它所包含的东西展开，从而对自己变得清明。
但我们也看到，这个信仰王国只是在思维的要素中、无概念地展开它的内容，并因此在它的命运中毁灭，即在启蒙的宗教中毁灭。
在这种宗教中，知性的那个超感性的彼岸重新建立起来，但却是这样：自我意识满足地站在此岸，而这个超感性之物——那个空洞的、既不可认识也不可恐惧的彼岸——，它既不知道它是自我，也不知道它是威力。

en: In the religion of morality, it is finally restored that the absolute essence is a positive content; but it is united with the negativity of the Enlightenment.
It is a being that is just as much taken back into the self and remains enclosed therein, and a differentiated content whose parts are just as immediately negated as they are posited.
But the fate in which this contradictory movement sinks is the self that is conscious of itself as the fate of essence and actuality.
zh: 在道德的宗教中，终于又恢复了这一点：绝对本质是一个肯定的内容；但它是与启蒙的否定性结合在一起的。
它是一种存在，这种存在同样被收回到自我之中、并且封闭于其中；它又是一种有差别的内容，这种内容的各个部分被直接否定，正如它们被树立起来一样。
而这种矛盾的运动会沉没于其中的那个命运，就是那个意识到自己就是本质与现实性的命运的自我。

en: The spirit that knows itself is in religion immediately its own pure self-consciousness.

Those shapes of the same that have been considered – the true spirit, the self-estranged spirit, and the spirit certain of itself – together constitute it in its consciousness, which, stepping over against its world, does not recognize itself in it.
But in conscience he subjects to himself, just as his objective world as such, so too his representation and his determinate concepts, and is now self-consciousness that is with itself.

In this, he has for himself, represented as an object, the significance of being the universal spirit that contains all essence and all actuality within itself, but he is not in the form of free actuality, or of nature appearing independently.

He indeed has a shape, or the form of being, insofar as he is an object of his consciousness; but because this consciousness is posited in religion in the essential determination of being self-consciousness, the shape is completely transparent to itself; and the actuality he contains is enclosed in him or sublated in him, precisely in the way as when we say 'all actuality'; it is the thought universal actuality.
zh: 那知道自己本身的精神，在宗教中直接就是它自己的纯粹的自我意识。
那些已经被考察过的、它的形态——真的精神、自身异化了的精神、以及对自己有把握的精神——合在一起构成了这个他在他的意识中的样子；这种意识走到它的世界的对面，却认不出自己就在这个世界之中。
但在良心中，他使他的对象性世界本身、他的表象和特定概念统统服从于自己，并且现在是与自身同在的自我意识。
在这种自我意识中，他被表象为对象，对自己而言具有这样的意义：他就是那个把一切本质和一切现实性都包含在自身之内的普遍精神；但他并不处在自由的现实性的形式中，也不处在独立显现着的自然的形式中。
他固然有形态，或者说有存在的形式，因为他是他的意识的对象；但因为这个意识在宗教中被设定在“是自我意识”这个本质的规定之中，所以这形态对自己是完全透明的；而他所包含的现实性被封闭在他之内、或者说在他之内被扬弃，恰好就像我们说“一切现实性”时那样；这种现实性就是被思维的普遍现实性。

en: Since, therefore, in religion the determination of spirit's proper consciousness does not have the form of free otherness, its determinate being is distinguished from its self-consciousness, and its proper actuality falls outside religion; it is indeed one spirit of both, but its consciousness does not comprehend both at once, and religion appears as one part of its determinate being, doing, and striving, whose other part is the life in its actual world.

Now, just as we know that the spirit in its world and the spirit conscious of itself as spirit, or the spirit in religion, are the same, so the consummation of religion consists in this, that both become equal to each other – not only that its actuality is comprehended by religion, but conversely that it, as spirit conscious of itself, becomes actual and the object of its consciousness.
– Insofar as the spirit in religion represents itself to itself, it is indeed consciousness, and the actuality enclosed therein is the shape and the garment of its representation.

But in this representation actuality does not receive its full right, namely not only to be a garment, but to be an independent, free determinate being; and conversely, because it lacks consummation within itself, it is a determinate shape that does not attain what it is supposed to present, namely the spirit conscious of itself.
For its shape to express him himself, it would itself have to be nothing other than he, and he would have to have appeared or be actual in the way he is in his essence.

Only thereby would that also be attained which may seem to be the demand of the opposite, namely that the object of his consciousness at the same time has the form of free actuality; but only the spirit that is an object to itself as absolute spirit is, for itself, an equally free actuality, just as it remains conscious of itself therein.
zh: 所以，既然在宗教中，精神真正意识的规定不具有自由的他在这种形式，那么它的定在就与它的自我意识区别开来，它真正的现实性就落在宗教之外；它固然是这两者的同一个精神，但它的意识并没有同时把两者都包揽起来，而宗教显现为它的定在、行动和活动的一个部分，这个部分的另一个部分就是在它现实世界中的生活。
现在，正如我们知道：精神在它的世界中，与那个意识到自己是精神的精神、或者说宗教中的精神，是同一个东西；同样，宗教的完成就在于：这两者相互等同起来——不仅是它的现实性被宗教所包揽，而且反过来，它作为意识到自身的精神成为现实的，并成为它的意识的对象。
——就精神在宗教中向自己表象自己而言，它固然是意识，而在其中被封闭起来的现实性，就是它的表象的形态和衣裳。
但在这种表象中，现实性并没有得到它完全应得的权利，那就是：它不只是衣裳，而是独立而自由的定在；反过来，由于它在自身之内缺少那种完成，它就是一种特定的形态，这种形态达不到它应当展现的那个东西，即意识到自身的精神。
要使他的形态表达出他本身，这形态本身就必须不是别的、正是他本人，而他必须像他在其本质中那样显现出来、或者说那样成为现实的。
只有借此才会同时也达到那个看起来可能像是相反要求的东西，即：他的意识的对象同时具有自由现实性的形式；但只有那个把自己作为绝对精神来当作对象的精神，才对自己是一种同样自由的现实性，正如它在这种现实性中仍然意识到自身一样。

en: In that, to begin with, self-consciousness and consciousness proper, religion, and spirit in its world, or the determinate being of spirit, are distinguished, the latter consists in the whole of spirit, insofar as its moments present themselves as stepping apart and each presents itself for itself.
These moments, however, are consciousness, self-consciousness, reason, and spirit — spirit, namely, as immediate spirit, which is not yet the consciousness of spirit.
Their concentrated totality constitutes spirit in its worldly determinate being as such; spirit as such contains the previous shapes in the universal determinations, the moments just named.
Religion presupposes the whole course of them and is the simple totality, or the absolute self, of them.
– Their course, moreover, is not to be represented as in time in relation to religion.

Only the whole spirit is in time, and the shapes that are shapes of the whole spirit as such present themselves in a succession; for only the whole has proper actuality, and hence the form of pure freedom over against an other, which expresses itself as time.
But the moments of the whole — consciousness, self-consciousness, reason, and spirit — have, because they are moments, no determinate being distinct from one another.
– Just as spirit was distinguished from its moments, so, thirdly, their isolated determination is still to be distinguished from these moments themselves.

For we saw that each of those moments, again, within itself distinguished itself in a course of its own and shaped itself variously; as, e.g., in consciousness, sense-certainty and perception distinguished themselves.
These latter sides step apart in time and belong to a particular whole,
– For spirit descends from its universality, through determination, down to singularity.
The determination, or the middle, is consciousness, self-consciousness, and so on.
But singularity is made up by the shapes of these moments.
These therefore present spirit in its singularity or actuality and distinguish themselves in time, yet in such a way that the following one retains the preceding ones within itself.
zh: 如果我们首先把自我意识和本来的意识、宗教，以及在它的世界中的精神或精神的定在区别开来，那么，后者就在于精神的整体，即精神的诸环节表现为分离着走出来、并且每一个都自为地呈现自己。
但这些环节就是意识、自我意识、理性和精神——也就是作为直接的精神的那种精神，它还不是关于精神的意识。
它们合起来的总体性，构成处于其世俗定在中的精神本身；作为这样的精神，精神把此前的诸形态包含在那些普遍的规定里，也就是刚才提到的那些环节里。
宗教以它们的整个进程为前提，并且是它们的简单总体性，或者说它们的绝对自我。
——此外，就与宗教的关系而言，它们的进程不能设想为处在时间之中。
只有整个精神才在时间中，而那些作为这样的整个精神的形态的诸形态，则在一种先后相继中呈现出来；因为只有整体才具有本来的现实性，因而才具有相对于他物的纯粹自由的形式，这种自由把自身表达为时间。
但整体的这些环节——意识、自我意识、理性和精神——因为它们是环节，所以并没有彼此不同的定在。
——正如精神曾被从它的诸环节中区分出来，那么，第三，还须从这些环节本身之中，把它们的单个化的规定区分出来。
因为我们看到，那些环节中的每一个，又都在它自身之内、在自己的一个进程中区分自己，并把自己塑造成种种不同的形态；例如在意识那里，感性确定性和知觉就彼此区分开来。
这些后一种方面在时间中彼此分离开来，并属于一个特殊的整体，
——因为精神从它的普遍性出发，通过规定而下降到个别性。
这个规定，或者说中项，就是意识、自我意识等等。
但个别性则是由这些环节的诸形态构成的。
因此，这些形态把精神呈现于它的个别性或现实性之中，并在时间中彼此区分开来，不过是这样：后一个形态把前面的诸形态保持在自身之内。

en: If, therefore, religion is the completion of spirit, into which the individual moments of it — consciousness, self-consciousness, reason, and spirit — go back, and have gone back, as into their ground, then together they constitute the actuality in its determinate being of the whole spirit, which is only as the distinguishing and self-returning movement of these its sides.
The becoming of religion in general is contained in the movement of the universal moments.

But in that each of these attributes was presented not only as it determines itself in general, but as it is in and for itself, i.e., as it runs its course within itself as a whole, there thereby arose not only the becoming of religion in general, but those complete courses of the individual sides likewise contain the determinacies of religion itself.

The whole spirit, the spirit of religion, is again the movement of arriving, out of its immediacy, at the knowing of what it is in itself or immediately, and of achieving that the shape in which it appears for its consciousness wholly resemble its essence, and that it intuit itself as it is.

– In this becoming, therefore, it is itself in determinate shapes, which constitute the differences of this movement; at the same time, the determinate religion thereby likewise has a determinate actual spirit.

If, therefore, consciousness, self-consciousness, reason, and spirit belong in general to the self-knowing spirit, then to the determinate shapes of the self-knowing spirit belong the determinate forms which developed within consciousness, self-consciousness, reason, and spirit, in each one in a distinctive way.
The determinate shape of religion reaches out, for its actual spirit, among the shapes of each of its moments, for that one which corresponds to it.
The one determinacy of religion reaches through all the sides of its actual determinate being and impresses on them this common stamp.
zh: 因此，如果宗教是精神的完成——精神的那些个别环节，即意识、自我意识、理性和精神，作为回到它们的根据之中、并且已经回到它们的根据之中的东西——那么，它们合起来就构成整个精神的定在着的现实性；这个精神只是作为它这些方面的有所区分并回到自身之中的运动而存在。
宗教一般的生成，包含在那些普遍环节的运动之中。
但是，既然这些属性中的每一个，都不仅按照它如何一般地规定自己，而且按照它自在自为地如何——也就是说，它如何在自身之内作为整体展开自己的进程——而被表述出来，那么，由此产生出来的就不仅是一般宗教的生成，而且，那些个别方面的完整进程同时也包含着宗教本身的各种规定性。
整个精神，即宗教的精神，又是一种运动：从它的直接性出发，达到对它所自在地、或者说直接地是的东西的知识，并且达到这一点：它在其意识面前显现出来的那种形态与它的本质完全相符，并且它直观到自己如其所是的样子。
——因此，在这种生成中，精神自己就处于特定的诸形态之中，这些形态构成了这一运动的种种差别；同时，特定的宗教也就因此同样具有一个特定的现实精神。
因此，如果意识、自我意识、理性和精神一般地属于那个认识自身的精神，那么，属于这个认识自身的精神的诸特定形态的，就是那些特定的形式，它们是在意识、自我意识、理性和精神之中、于每一个里面以各自特殊的方式展开出来的。
宗教的特定形态，为了它的现实精神，从它的每一个环节的诸形态之中，挑出那个与它相适应的形态来。
宗教的这同一个规定性，贯穿于它的现实定在的所有方面，并把这种共同的印记打在它们身上。

en: In this way the shapes that have appeared so far now arrange themselves otherwise than they appeared in their series, about which what is necessary is still to be briefly remarked beforehand.

– In the series under consideration, each moment, deepening itself into itself, formed itself into a whole in its own peculiar principle; and cognition was the depth, or the spirit, in which they — who for themselves have no subsistence — had their substance.

This substance, however, has now stepped forth; it is the depth of the spirit certain of itself, which does not permit the individual principle to isolate itself and make itself, within itself, into a whole, but rather, gathering and holding together all these moments within itself, it advances in this entire wealth of its actual spirit, and all its particular moments commonly take up and receive into themselves the same determinacy of the whole.
– This spirit certain of itself, and its movement, is their true actuality and the in-and-for-itself that pertains to each individual.

– If, therefore, the previous single series, in its progression, marked the retrogressions within itself by nodes, but out of them continued again into a length, it is now, as it were, broken at these nodes, the universal moments, and has fallen apart into many lines, which, drawn together into a bond, at the same time unite symmetrically, so that the same differences, into which each particular line shaped itself within itself, converge.

– It is, moreover, self-evident from the whole presentation how this coordination of the universal directions presented here is to be understood, so that it becomes superfluous to make the remark that these differences are essentially to be grasped only as moments of becoming, not as parts; in the actual spirit they are attributes of its substance, but in religion rather only predicates of the subject.

– Likewise, in themselves or for us, all forms in general are certainly contained in spirit and in each; but in regard to its actuality in general it comes down solely to this: which determinacy is present for it in its consciousness, in which it has expressed its self, or in which shape it knows its essence.
zh: 这样一来，迄今出现过的那些形态，就按一种不同于它们在序列中显现的方式排列起来了；关于这一点，还须事先简短地说一下必要的话。
——在刚才考察的那个序列中，每一个环节都在自身之内不断深化，把自己塑造成一个处于它特有的原则之中的整体；而认识则是那个深处，或者说那种精神，诸环节在其中——它们自为地并无持存——拥有其实体。
但如今，这个实体已经走了出来；它就是那个自身确定的精神的深处，这个深处不允许那单个的原则把自己孤立起来、在自身之内把自己弄成一个整体，而是把所有这些环节都收拢在自身之内并凝聚在一起，在这个现实精神的整个财富之中继续前进；于是，它所有特殊的环节都共同地把整体的这同一个规定性接纳并接收到自身之中。
——这个自身确定的精神及其运动，就是它们的真正的现实性，就是那属于每一个个别者的自在自为存在。
——因此，如果此前那一条唯一的序列，在它前进的过程中，用结点标示出它内部的一次次回退，却又从这些回退之中再次延伸成一条长线，那么，如今它仿佛是在这些结点——即那些普遍环节——之处折断了，碎裂成许多条线；这些线被收拢进一个联结之中，同时对称地联合起来，以至于每一条特殊的线在自身之内塑造成的那些同样的差别，相互会合在一起。
——此外，从整个表述之中本来就不言自明：这里所呈现的普遍方向的这种并列应当如何理解，以至于再去作这样一番说明就成了多余：这些差别本质上只能作为生成的环节来把握，而不能作为部分来把握；在现实的精神那里，它们是其实体的属性，而在宗教那里，它们毋宁只是主体的谓词。
——同样，一切形式一般而言当然都自在地、或者说对我们而言包含在精神之中，也包含在每一个（环节）之中；但就精神的现实性一般而言，唯一要紧的只是：哪一种规定性在它的意识中呈现在它面前，它在这种规定性中表达了自己的自身，或者说，它以哪一种形态认识自己的本质。

en: The difference that was made between the actual spirit and the spirit that knows itself as spirit, or between itself as consciousness and as self-consciousness, is sublated in the spirit that knows itself according to its truth; its consciousness and its self-consciousness are balanced.
But since religion is here as yet only immediate, this difference has not yet returned into the spirit.
Only the concept of religion is posited; in it the essence is the self-consciousness that is to itself all truth and in this contains all actuality.

This self-consciousness, as consciousness, has itself for its object; the spirit that only now first knows itself immediately is thus to itself spirit in the form of immediacy, and the determinacy of the shape in which it appears to itself is that of being.

This being is indeed filled neither with sensation nor with the manifold matter, nor yet with other one-sided moments, purposes, and determinations, but rather with spirit, and is known by itself as all truth and actuality.
This fulfilment is in this way not equal to its shape, he as essence not equal to his consciousness.

He is only actual as absolute spirit insofar as he, just as he is to himself in the certainty of himself, is also to himself in his truth; or the extremes into which he divides himself as consciousness are for one another in the shape of spirit.

The formation that the spirit assumes as the object of its consciousness remains filled by the certainty of the spirit as by the substance; through this content there disappears that the object would sink down to a pure objectivity, to the form of the negativity of self-consciousness.
The immediate unity of the spirit with itself is the foundation or pure consciousness, within which consciousness steps apart.

Enclosed in this way in its pure self-consciousness, it does not exist in religion as the creator of a nature as such; rather, what it brings forth in this movement are its shapes as spirits, which together constitute the completeness of its appearance, and this movement itself is the becoming of its perfect actuality through the individual sides of the same, or through its imperfect actualities.
zh: 在现实的精神与那个把自己知道为精神的精神之间，或者说在作为意识和作为自我意识的自身之间造成的那个差别，在那种按照自己的真理知道自身的精神中被扬弃了；它的意识与它的自我意识已经彼此平衡。
不过，由于宗教在这里还只是直接的，这个差别就还没有回到精神中去。
这里只设定了宗教的概念；在这个概念里，本质就是自我意识，它对自己就是全部真理，并且在这种真理中包含全部现实性。
这个自我意识，作为意识，把自己当作自己的对象；那个起初才直接地知道自己的精神，因此就以直接性的形式对自身呈现为精神，而它向自身显现于其中的那种形态的规定性，就是存在的规定性。
这个存在虽然既没有被感觉或纷繁多样的质料所充实，也没有被其他片面的环节、目的和规定所充实，而是被精神所充实，并且被它自身知道为全部的真理和现实性。
这种充实以这种方式与它的形态不相称，他作为本质与他的意识不相称。
只有作为绝对精神，他才是现实的，即他如何在自己的确定性中对自身存在，也就如何在自己的真理中对自身存在；或者说，他作为意识而分裂开来的那些极端，是以精神的形态互为对方而存在的。
精神作为自己意识的对象而采取的形态化，始终被精神对自己的确定性所充实，就像被实体所充实一样；通过这个内容，对象会沉沦为纯粹的对象性、即自我意识的否定性的形式——这种情况就消失了。
精神与其自身的直接统一，就是基础或纯粹意识，而意识就在这个纯粹意识之内分裂开来。
以这种方式被封闭在它的纯粹自我意识之中，它在宗教中就不是作为某个一般的自然的创造者而存在；毋宁说，它在这种运动中所产生出来的，是它作为诸精神而有的那些形态，它们合在一起构成它的现象的完备性，而这个运动本身，就是通过这一现实性的各个侧面、或者说通过它那些不完满的现实性，来生成它的完满现实性的过程。

en: The first actuality of the same is the concept of religion itself, or religion as immediate and hence natural religion; in it the spirit knows itself as its object in natural or immediate shape.
The second, however, is necessarily this: to know itself in the shape of sublated naturalness, or of the self.

It is therefore the artificial religion; for the shape raises itself to the form of the self through the bringing-forth of consciousness, whereby the latter intuits in its object its own doing or the self.
The third, finally, sublates the one-sidedness of the first two; the self is just as much an immediate one as immediacy is the self.

If in the first religion the spirit is generally in the form of consciousness, and in the second in that of self-consciousness, then in the third it is in the form of the unity of both; it has the shape of being-in-and-for-itself; and since it is thus represented as it is in and for itself, this is the revealed religion.

But although in it he does indeed attain his true shape, still the shape itself and the representation remain the not-yet-overcome side, from which he must pass over into the concept, in order to dissolve within it completely the form of objectivity – within it, which just as much encloses in itself this, its opposite.
Then the spirit has grasped the concept of itself, just as we have only now grasped it; and its shape, or the element of its determinate being, insofar as it is the concept, is he himself.
zh: 宗教的第一个现实性，就是宗教概念本身，或者说宗教作为直接的、因而也就是自然的宗教；在这种宗教里，精神以自然的或直接的形态把自己知道为它的对象。
第二种现实性则必然是这样的：在被扬弃了的自然性、或自身的形态中知道自己。
所以它就是人工宗教，因为形态通过意识的产生活动把自己提升到自身的形式，意识借此在自己的对象中直观到自己的行动，或者说直观到自身。
第三种宗教最终扬弃前两种的片面性；自身同样是一个直接的东西，正如直接性也就是自身一样。
如果说在第一种宗教里，精神一般地处于意识的形式中，在第二种宗教里处于自我意识的形式中，那么在第三种宗教里，它就处于这两者统一的形式中；它具有自在自为存在的形态；而由于它正因此被表象为它自在自为地所是的样子，所以这就是天启宗教。
不过，即使他在其中确实达到了自己的真的形态，这种形态本身和表象也仍然是没有被克服的一面，他必须从这一面过渡到概念中去，以便在概念中把对象性的形式完全消解掉——在这个概念中，这个概念同样把它自己的对立面包含在自身之内。
到那时，精神就把握住了自身的概念，正如我们到现在才把握住它一样；而它的形态、即它的定在的元素，由于它就是这个概念，所以也就是精神自己本身。

en: The spirit that knows the spirit is consciousness of itself and is to itself in the form of the objective; it is – and is at the same time being-for-itself.
It is for itself; it is the side of self-consciousness, namely over against the side of its consciousness, or of its relating of itself to itself as object.
In its consciousness there is the opposition, and through it the determinacy of the shape in which it appears to itself and knows itself.
In this consideration of religion it is solely a matter of this, for its unshaped essence, or its pure concept, has already come forth.

But the difference of consciousness and self-consciousness falls at the same time within the latter; the shape of religion does not contain the determinate being of the spirit as it is nature free from thought, nor as it is thought free from determinate being; rather, it is the determinate being preserved in thinking, just like a thought-being that is there to itself.

– According to the determinacy of this shape, in which the spirit knows itself, one religion is distinguished from another; at the same time, however, it is to be noted that the presentation of this its knowing of itself, according to this single determinacy, does not in fact exhaust the whole of an actual religion.

The series of the different religions that will come forth likewise presents again only the different sides of a single religion, indeed of each single one, and the representations which seem to distinguish an actual religion from another occur in every one.
But at the same time this difference must also be regarded as a difference of religion.

For insofar as the spirit finds itself in the difference of its consciousness and its self-consciousness, the movement has the aim of sublating this chief difference and of giving the form of self-consciousness to the shape that is the object of consciousness.
But this difference is not already sublated through the fact that the shapes which the former contains also have the moment of the self on them, and that God is represented as self-consciousness.

The represented self is not the actual one; that it, like every other nearer determination of the shape, truly belongs to this shape, must partly be posited into it through the doing of self-consciousness, and partly the lower determination must show itself to be sublated and comprehended by the higher.

For the represented ceases to be represented and alien to its knowing only through this, that the self has brought it forth and therefore intuits the determination of the object as its own, and hence intuits itself in it,

– Through this activity the lower determination has at the same time disappeared; for the doing is the negative, which executes itself at the cost of another; insofar as it still occurs, it has stepped back into inessentiality; just as, on the contrary, where the lower is still dominant but the higher also occurs, the one has place next to the other without a self.

If, therefore, the different representations within a single religion do present the whole movement of its forms, still the character of each is determined by the particular unity of consciousness and self-consciousness, i.e. by the fact that the latter has taken into itself the determination of the object of the former, has through its doing fully appropriated it, and knows it as the essential one over against the others,

– The truth of the faith in a determination of the religious spirit shows itself in this, that the actual spirit is constituted just like the shape in which it intuits itself in religion – as, e.g., the incarnation of God, which occurs in the Oriental religion, has no truth, because its actual spirit is without this reconciliation.

– It does not belong here to return from the totality of the determinations to the single one, and to show in which shape, within it and within its particular religion, the completeness of the rest is contained.
The higher form, set back under a lower one, is deprived of its significance for the self-conscious spirit; it belongs to it only superficially and to its representation.
It is to be considered in its proper significance, and there, where it is the principle of this particular religion and is validated through its actual spirit.
zh: 那个认识精神的精神，是对自身的意识，并且以对象之物的形式对自身存在；它就是——并且同时就是自为存在。
它是自为的，它是自我意识的那一面，而且是相对于它的意识那一面、即相对于把自己当作对象来关联的那一面而言的。
在它的意识中存在着对立，并由此存在着那种形态的规定性，它就在这种形态中向自身显现并且知道自身。
在对宗教的这种考察中，要紧的唯独是这一点，因为它的未成形的本质、或者说它的纯粹概念，已经呈现出来了。
但意识与自我意识的差别，同时就落在后者之内；宗教的形态所包含的，不是精神作为摆脱了思想的自然而有的那种定在，也不是它作为摆脱了定在的思想而有的那种定在；毋宁说，它是保持在思想中的定在，就像是一个对自身在场的被思想之物一样。
——一种宗教与另一种宗教的区分，就是按照这种形态的规定性作出的，精神就在这种形态中知道自己；但同时也必须注意到，按照这种单一的规定性对这种自我认识所作的呈现，事实上并没有穷尽一个现实宗教的整体。
将要呈现出来的各种不同宗教的序列，同样地又只是表现出唯一一种宗教、而且恰恰是每一单个宗教的不同侧面，而那些似乎使一个现实宗教区别于另一个现实宗教的表象，在每一个宗教里都会出现。
但与此同时，这种差异性也必须被看作宗教的差异性。
因为，既然精神处在它的意识与它的自我意识的差别之中，那么这种运动就以扬弃这个主要差别、并且给那个作为意识之对象的形态加上自我意识的形式为目标。
但是，这个差别并不会因为下面这一点就已经被扬弃了：前者所包含的那些形态也在自己身上带有自身的环节，并且上帝被表象为自我意识。
被表象的自身并不是现实的自身；它要像这种形态的任何其他更切近的规定一样真正地属于这种形态，这一点一方面必须通过自我意识的行动被设定到这种形态中去，另一方面，较低的规定必须表明自己是被较高的规定所扬弃并且被以概念把握了的。
因为被表象之物只有通过这一点才不再是表象之物、不再与它的知识相异己，即：自身已经把它产生出来，因而把对象的规定当作自己的规定来直观，从而在它之中直观到自己，
——通过这种活动，较低的规定同时也就消失了；因为行动是否定的东西，它以牺牲另一个为代价来实行自己；只要它还出现，它就已经退回到不本质性之中；与此相反，凡是较低的规定仍然占支配地位、而较高的规定也出现的地方，这一方就无自身地与另一方并列占有一席之地。
因此，如果单个宗教内部的各种不同表象确实呈现出它的诸形态的整个运动，那么其中每一个表象的特性，都是由意识与自我意识的特定统一决定的，也就是说，是由这一点决定的：后者已经把前者的对象的规定收进自身，通过自己的行动把它完全据为己有，并且把它当作本质性的规定、与其余规定相对地知道，
——对一个宗教精神之规定的信仰，其真理性表现在：现实的精神恰好像那种形态一样被构成，即它在宗教中于其中直观到自身的那个形态，——比如，东方宗教中出现的上帝的道成肉身就没有真理性，因为它的现实的精神是没有这种和解的。
——从规定的总体性返回到单一的规定，并指出在它内部、在它那个特定宗教内部，其余规定的完备性是以何种形态被包含着的，这并不属于这里要做的事。
较高的形式若被置回到较低的形式之下，就缺失了它对于有自我意识的精神的意义，它只以表面的方式属于精神，并且只属于精神的表象。
它应当在它特有的意义上、并且应当在其成为这种特定宗教的原则、并通过这种宗教的现实的精神得到证实的地方来考察。

en: Spirit, as the essence that is self-consciousness — or the self-conscious essence that is all truth and knows all actuality as itself — is, against the reality that it gives itself in the movement of its consciousness, as yet only its concept; and this concept is, against the day of this unfolding, the night of its essence, and against the determinate being of its moments as independent shapes, the creative mystery of its birth.

This mystery has its revelation in itself; for determinate being has its necessity in this concept, because it is the self-knowing spirit and hence in its essence has the moment of being consciousness and of representing itself objectively.
– It is the pure I, which in its externalization has the certainty of itself in itself as a universal object; or this object is for it the interpenetration of all thinking and all actuality.
zh: 精神，作为那种本身就是自我意识的本质——或者说，作为那种就是全部真理、并把一切现实性都认识为它自身的自我意识的本质——相对于它在自己意识的运动中给予自己的那种实在性而言，还只是它的概念；而这个概念，相对于这种展开的白昼而言，就是它本质的黑夜，相对于它的诸环节作为独立形态的定在而言，就是它诞生的创造性奥秘。
这个奥秘在自身中就有它的启示；因为定在在这个概念中有它的必然性，因为它是认识着自身的精神，从而在它的本质中具有成为意识、并把自己当作对象来表象的环节。
——它就是纯粹的自我；它在自己的外化中，在自身这个普遍对象身上，拥有对自身的确定性；或者说，这个对象对它而言，就是一切思维与一切现实性的贯通。

en: In the immediate first sundering of the absolute spirit that knows itself, its shape has that determination which belongs to immediate consciousness or to sense-certainty.

It beholds itself in the form of being, though not of the spiritless being that is filled with contingent determinations of sensation and belongs to sense-certainty, but it is the being that is filled with spirit.
It likewise includes within itself the form that occurred in immediate self-consciousness, the form of the master against the self-consciousness of spirit that steps back from its object.
– This being filled with the concept of spirit is therefore the shape of the simple relation of spirit to itself, or the shape of shapelessness.
By virtue of this determination, it is the pure light-being of the rising, containing and filling everything, which maintains itself in its formless substantiality.

Its otherness is the equally simple negative, the darkness; the movements of its own externalization, its creations in the unresisting element of its otherness, are outpourings of light; and in their simplicity they are at once its becoming-for-itself and its return from its determinate being, fire-streams that consume shape-formation.

The difference that it gives itself indeed proliferates in the substance of determinate being and shapes itself into the forms of nature; but the essential simplicity of its thinking roams about in them without subsistence and without understanding, extends their boundaries to the measureless, and dissolves their beauty, heightened to splendor, in their sublimity.
zh: 在认识自身的绝对精神的最初的直接分裂中，它的形态具有那种归属于直接意识或感性确定性的规定。
它在存在的形式中直观自己，不过不是那种属于感性确定性的、无精神的、充满感觉的偶然规定的存在，而是以精神充盈的存在。
它同样把那种在直接自我意识中出现过的形式包揽在自身之中，即主人对那种从它的对象那里退回来的精神自我意识的形式。
——这种以精神的概念充盈的存在，因此就是精神对自身的简单关系的形态，或者说，无形态性的形态。
凭借这种规定，它就是升起的那种纯粹的、包含一切并充盈一切的光明本质，它在自己无形式的实体性中维持自身。
它的他在就是同样单纯的否定者，即黑暗；它自身外化的种种运动，即它在自己他在的无抵抗元素中的种种创造，都是光的倾泻；它们在单纯性中，同时就是它成为自为的过程和从它的定在中的返回，是吞噬着赋形的火流。
它给予自己的差别，诚然在定在的实体中蔓延滋长，把自己塑造成自然的种种形式；但它思维的这种本质的单纯性，却在它们中间无持存地、不明事理地四处游荡，把它们的边界扩展到无度，并把它们那种提升为华丽的美消解在它们的崇高之中。

en: The content that this pure being develops, or its perceiving, is therefore an essenceless playing-along upon this substance, which only rises, without descending into itself, becoming subject, and securing its differences through the self.
Its determinations are only attributes, which do not thrive into independence but remain only names of the many-named One.

This One is clothed with the manifold forces of determinate being and the shapes of actuality, as with a selfless ornament; they are only messengers devoid of their own will, intuitions of his glory, and voices of his praise.
But this reeling life must determine itself to being-for-itself and give subsistence to its vanishing shapes.
The immediate being, in which it sets itself over against its consciousness, is itself the negative power that dissolves its differences.
It is therefore in truth the self; and spirit accordingly passes over into knowing itself in the form of the self.
The pure light scatters its simplicity apart as an infinity of forms and offers itself up as a sacrifice to being-for-itself, so that the individual may take its subsistence from its substance.
zh: 因此，这种纯粹存在所发展的内容，或者说它的知觉，只是在这种实体上的一种无本质的伴戏；这种实体只知升起，却不在自身中沉降，不成为主体，也不通过自我来巩固它的种种差别。
它的种种规定只是些属性，这些属性长不成独立性，而只是多名的太一的诸多名字。
这个太一被披上定在的种种纷繁之力与现实性的种种形态，如同披上一种无自我的装饰；它们只是缺乏自身意志的使者，是对他的荣耀的直观，是颂扬他的声音。
但这种踉跄的生命，却必须把自己规定为自为存在，并给它那些消逝着的形态以持存。
它向自己的意识对立起来的那个直接存在，本身就是消解它的种种差别的否定的力量。
所以它实际上就是自我；而精神因此过渡到以自我的形式来认识自身。
纯粹的光把自己的单纯性抛散为一种形式的无限性，并把自己当作祭品献祭给自为存在，好让个别者从它的实体那里取走自己的持存。

20.en: b. The Plant and the Animal

en: The self-conscious spirit, which has gone into itself out of the formless essence or has raised its immediacy to the self in general, determines its simplicity as a manifold of being-for-itself and is the religion of spiritual perception, wherein it breaks apart into the countless multiplicity of weaker and stronger, richer and poorer spirits.
This pantheism, at first the calm subsistence of these spirit-atoms, becomes a hostile movement within itself.

The innocence of the flower religion, which is only the selfless representation of the self, passes over into the earnestness of struggling life, into the guilt of the animal religion; the rest and powerlessness of intuiting individuality passes over into destructive being-for-itself.

– It does not help to have taken the death of abstraction from the things of perception and to have raised them to essences of spiritual perception; the ensoulment of this realm of spirits has brought that death back through the determinacy and the negativity attaching to it, which reaches over the innocent indifference of those things.
Through it, the dispersal into the manifold of calm plant-shapes becomes a hostile movement, wherein the hatred of their being-for-itself wears itself out.

– The actual self-consciousness of this dispersed spirit is a multitude of isolated, unsociable national spirits, which in their hatred fight one another to the death and become conscious of determinate animal shapes as their essence, for they are nothing other than animal spirits, animal lives that separate themselves off and are conscious of themselves without universality.
zh: 自我意识的精神从无形态的本质中回到自身，或者说把自己的直接性提升为一般的自我；它把自己的单纯性规定为一种自为存在的杂多性，并且就是精神的知觉的宗教；在这种宗教里，它分裂为无数众多更弱与更强、更丰富与更贫乏的精神。
这种泛神论起初是这些精神原子的宁静持存，随后变成自身之中的敌对运动。
花之宗教的天真——它只是自我的无自我的表象——过渡为搏斗生命的严肃，过渡为动物宗教的罪过；直观着的个体性的安宁与无力，过渡为摧毁性的自为存在。
——即使把抽象之死从知觉的物身上取走，并把它们提升为精神知觉的本质，也无济于事；这个精神王国的赋灵，通过附着于其上的、越过了它们的无辜的漠然的那种规定性和否定性，把这种死亡又带了回来。
凭借这种规定性和否定性，分散在宁静的植物形态的杂多性中的东西，变成一种敌对运动，在这种运动中，它们的自为存在的仇恨消耗殆尽。
——这种分散精神的现实的自我意识，是许多孤立的、不合群的民族精神；它们在仇恨中拼死搏斗，并意识到特定的动物形态就是它们的本质，因为它们不是别的，正是动物精神，是彼此分离、毫无普遍性地意识着自身的动物生命。

en: In this hatred, however, the determinacy of the purely negative being-for-itself wears itself out, and through this movement of the concept spirit passes over into another shape.
The sublated being-for-itself is the form of the object, which is produced through the self or rather is the produced, self-exhausting self, i.e., the self that becomes a thing.
Over the merely tearing animal spirits, therefore, the worker gains the upper hand, whose doing is not only negative but calmed and positive.
The consciousness of spirit is thus henceforth the movement that lies beyond immediate being-in-itself as well as beyond abstract being-for-itself.

Inasmuch as the in-itself is reduced to a determinacy through the opposition, it is no longer the own form of the absolute spirit, but an actuality that its consciousness finds set over against itself as the common determinate being, sublates it, and is likewise not only this sublating being-for-itself but also produces its representation, the being-for-itself set out into the form of an object.
This producing, however, is not yet the complete one, but a conditioned activity and the forming of something at hand.
zh: 但是在这种仇恨中，纯粹否定的自为存在的规定性消耗殆尽，而通过概念的这种运动，精神转入另一种形态。
被扬弃的自为存在就是对象的形式；这种形式通过自我产生出来，或者毋宁说，它就是那个被产生出来的、自我消耗的自我，即变成了物的自我。
因此，劳动者压倒了那些只会撕裂的动物精神；他的行动不仅是否定的，而且是安宁的、肯定的。
因此，精神的意识如今就是这样的运动：它超出了直接的自在存在，也同样超出了抽象的自为存在。
既然自在通过对立被贬降为一种规定性，它就不再是绝对精神自身的形式，而是一种现实性；精神的意识把这种现实性当作普通的定在、作为对立物在自身面前发现，扬弃它，并且同样不仅是这种扬弃着的自为存在，而且产生出它的表象，即那个被置入对象形式之中的自为存在。
然而，这种产生还不是完全的产生，而是一种受条件制约的活动，是对某种现成者的赋形。

en: Spirit thus appears here as the artificer, and its doing, whereby it produces itself as object, but has not yet grasped the thought of it, is an instinct-like working, as the bees build their cells.
zh: 因此，精神在这里显现为工匠；而它的行动——它通过这种行动把自己产生为对象，却还没有把握其中的思想——就是一种本能式的工作，正如蜜蜂营造它们的蜂房。

en: The first form, because it is the immediate one, is the abstract form of the understanding, and the work is not yet filled with spirit in itself.

The crystals of pyramids and obelisks — simple combinations of straight lines with plane surfaces and equal proportions of the parts, in which the incommensurability of the round is extirpated — are the works of this artificer of strict form.
For the sake of the mere intelligibility of the form, it is not its meaning in itself, not the spiritual self.

The works therefore receive spirit only either in themselves as an alien, departed spirit, which has left its living interpenetration with actuality and, itself dead, enters into these crystals devoid of life; or they relate externally to it as to one that is itself external and is not present as spirit — as to the rising light, which throws its meaning onto them.
zh: 第一种形式，由于它是直接的那种形式，就是知性的抽象形式；而作品在它自身之中还没有被精神充盈。
金字塔和方尖碑的晶体——直线与平面作简单的结合、各部分比例均等，其中圆的那种不可通约性已被消灭——就是这位严格形式的工匠的作品。
由于形式那种纯然的知性明理，它在它自身之中并不是它的意义，并不是精神的自我。
因此，作品们要么只是把精神作为一个异己的、已故的精神接受到自身之中——这种精神已经离开了它与现实性的活生生的贯通，本身已死，进入这些缺乏生命的晶体；要么，它们只是外在地与它发生关系，把它当作这样一种存在者：它本身也是外在的，并不作为精神而在场——就像对待那升起的光，它把自己的意义投到作品们身上。

en: The separation from which the working spirit sets out — of the being-in-itself, which becomes the material that it works on, and of the being-for-itself, which is the side of the working self-consciousness — has become objective for it in its work.
Its further endeavor must tend toward sublating this separation of soul and body — toward clothing and shaping the soul in itself, but toward ensouling the body.

The two sides, while being brought closer to one another, still retain the determinacy of the represented spirit and of its surrounding shell over against each other; its unity with itself contains this opposition of singularity and universality.

As the work in its sides draws nearer to itself, thereby at the same time the other also happens: that it steps nearer to the working self-consciousness, and that this arrives in the work at the knowledge of how it is in and for itself.
In this way, however, it constitutes only the abstract side of the activity of spirit, which knows its content not yet in itself, but at its work, which is a thing.

The artificer itself, the whole spirit, has not yet appeared, but is the still inner, hidden essence, which as a whole is present only divided up into the active self-consciousness and its produced object.
zh: 劳动着的精神由以出发的那种分离——即自在存在（它变成它所加工的质料）与自为存在（它是劳动着的自我意识的那一面）之间的分离——在他的作品中对他成了对象性的东西。
它进一步的努力必须致力于扬弃灵魂与身体的这种分离：把灵魂在它自身之中赋予形体并加以塑造，而把身体赋予灵魂。
双方在相互拉近的同时，仍然彼此保持着被表象的精神与其包围着的外壳的规定性；它对自身的统一本身就包含着个别性与普遍性的这种对立。
作品在它的诸方面中接近它自身，由此同时也发生着另一回事：它走近那劳动着的自我意识，而这个自我意识就在作品中达到了对它自在自为地如何的知识。
然而，这样它只构成精神活动的那个抽象的方面；这种活动还没有在它自身之中、而只是在它的作品——一个物——之中知道自己的内容。
工匠自己，那个整个的精神，还没有显现出来，而还是那个内在的、隐蔽着的本质；这个本质作为整体，只是分解为能动的自我意识和它产生出来的对象而存在着。

en: The surrounding dwelling, therefore — the external actuality, which is only first raised into the abstract form of the understanding — the artificer works out into a more ensouled form.

He uses plant life for this, which is no longer holy as it was for the earlier impotent pantheism, but is taken by him — who comprehends himself as the being that is for itself — as something useful and set back to the exterior and to ornament.

It is not used unchanged, however; rather, the worker of self-conscious form at the same time extirpates the perishability that the immediate existence of this life has in it, and brings its organic forms nearer to the stricter and more universal forms of thought.

The organic form, which, set free, keeps proliferating in particularity, is on its side subjugated by the form of thought, and on the other hand raises these rectilinear and planar shapes to a more ensouled roundness — a blending that becomes the root of free architecture.
zh: 因此，工匠把那周围的住所——那种外在的现实性，它只是先被提升到知性的抽象形式——加工成更有灵魂的形式。
为此他使用植物生命；这种生命不再像对于先前那种无力的泛神论那样是神圣的，而是被他——他把自己把握为自为存在着的本质——当作某种有用的东西取用，并被贬到外面、贬为装饰。
然而，它并不是不加改变地被使用的；相反，自觉形态的劳动者同时也消灭了这种生命的直接存在所具有的那种易逝性，并把它的有机形态拉近到思想的那种更严格、更普遍的形式。
有机形态被放任起来、在特殊性中不断蔓生，一方面被思想的形式所征服，另一方面又把那些直线条的、平面的形态提升为更有灵魂的圆润——这种混合就成了自由建筑的根。

en: This dwelling — the side of the universal element or of the inorganic nature of spirit — now also encloses within itself a shape of singularity, which brings the spirit previously separated from determinate being, the spirit inner or external to it, nearer to actuality, and thereby makes the work more like the active self-consciousness.
The worker first reaches over to the form of being-for-itself in general, to the animal shape.

That he is no longer immediately conscious of himself in animal life he proves by this: that he constitutes himself over against it as the productive force and knows himself in it as in his work; whereby it at the same time becomes a sublated thing and the hieroglyph of another meaning, of a thought.
Hence it is also no longer used by the worker alone and wholly, but is mixed with the shape of thought, with the human one.

The work, however, still lacks the shape and the determinate being in which the self exists as self; — it still lacks this: to express in itself that it contains an inner meaning within itself; it lacks language, the element in which the fulfilling sense itself is present.

The work, therefore, even when it has wholly purified itself of the animal and bears on itself alone the shape of self-consciousness, is the still toneless shape, which needs the ray of the rising sun in order to have a tone — a tone which, generated by the light, is likewise only a sound and not language, and shows only an external self, not the inner one.
zh: 这个住所——精神那个普遍要素或无机的自然的那一面——如今也把一种个别性的形态包揽在自身之中；这种形态把那个先前从定在分离出来的、内在于它或外在于它的精神带到现实性近旁，并由此使作品与能动的自我意识更为相似。
劳动者首先转而求取一般的自为存在的形式，即动物的形态。
他不再直接地在动物生命中意识到自己，他由此证明了这一点：他把自己构建为与动物生命相对立的那种产生着的力，并在它之中、作为他的作品来认识自己；由此，动物形态同时成为一种被扬弃的东西，成为另一种意义、一种思想的象形文字。
因此，劳动者也不再单独地、整个地使用它，而是把它同思想的形态、同人的形态混合起来。
然而，作品还缺少自我作为自我而存在的那种形态和定在；——它还缺少这样一点：在它自身之中说出它自身包含着一种内在的意义；它缺少语言，缺少那种要素，充实的意味本身就在其中。
因此，作品即使已经从动物性的东西中完全净化出来、只在自身之上带着自我意识的形态，它也还是那无声的形态；它需要升起的太阳的光芒才有声音——而这种由光产生的声音，仍然只是响声，不是语言，只显示出外在的自我，显示不出内在的自我。

en: Over against this external self of the shape stands the other, which indicates that it has an inner in it.

Nature, going back into its essence, degrades its living, self-isolating and, in its movement, self-entangling manifoldness to an unessential housing, which is the covering of the inner; and this inner is at first still the simple darkness, the unmoved, the black formless stone.
zh: 与形态的这个外在自我相对而立的，是另一个，它表明它有一个内在者。
返回到自己本质中去的自然，把它的活生生的、使自己个别化并在自身运动中陷于纷乱的杂多性，贬为一个无本质的躯壳，这躯壳就是内在者的覆盖物；而这个内在者起初还只是单纯的黑暗，那不动者，那黑色的无形式的石头。

en: Both presentations contain inwardness and determinate being — the two moments of spirit; and both presentations contain both at once in an opposite relation, the self as inner as well as outer.
Both are to be united.

The soul of the human-shaped statue does not yet come forth from within, is not yet language, the determinate being that is inwardly in itself — and the inner of the manifold-shaped determinate being is still the toneless, that which does not distinguish itself within itself and is not yet separated from its outer, to which all differences belong.

The artificer therefore unites both in the blending of the natural and the self-conscious shape, and these ambiguous, self-enigmatic beings — the conscious wrestling with the unconscious, the simple inner with the manifold outer, pairing the darkness of thought with the clarity of expression — break forth into the language of deep, hard-to-understand wisdom.
zh: 两种表述都包含着内在性和定在——精神的两个环节；并且两种表述都以对立的关系同时包含着两者，自我既作为内在者，也作为外在者。
两者必须联合起来。
人形雕像的灵魂还没有从内在之中走出来，还没有成为语言，还没有成为那种在自身之中即内在的定在；而那多形态的定在的内在者，还是无声的东西，还是那种不在自身之中区分自己、也还没有同它的外在者分离开来的东西，而一切差别都属于它的外在者。
因此，工匠在自然形态与自觉形态的混合中把两者联合起来；而这些模棱两可的、对自身成谜的存在者——有意识者与无意识者搏斗，单纯的内在者与多形态的外在者相交，把思想的黑暗同表现的清明配对在一起——就迸发为一种深沉的、难以理解的智慧的语言。

en: In this work the instinctive labor ceases, which, over against self-consciousness, produced the unconscious work; for in it an equally self-conscious inner life that gives expression to itself comes to meet the activity of the workmaster, which constitutes self-consciousness.
In it, he has worked himself up to the sundering of his consciousness, in which spirit encounters spirit.

In this unity of the self-conscious spirit with itself, insofar as it is the shape and object of its consciousness, its admixtures with the unconscious manner of the immediate natural shape thus purify themselves.

These monsters of shape, speech, and deed dissolve into spiritual formation — an outer that has gone into itself, an inner that expresses itself out of itself and at itself; into thought, which is a determinate being that gives birth to itself and preserves its shape in conformity with it, a clear determinate being.
Spirit is the artist.
zh: 在这个作品中，那种本能式的劳动中止了；这种劳动是相对于自我意识而产生出无意识的作品的，因为在这个作品里，一个同样自我意识着的、把自己表白出来的内在者，迎向了构成自我意识的工匠的活动。
他在其中把自己提升到了他的意识的分裂，在这种分裂中精神遇到了精神。
在这种自我意识的精神与自身的统一中——只要它是它意识的形态和对象——它那些与无意识的直接自然形态之方式的混杂，就得到了净化。
这些在形态、言语和行动上的怪物，消解为精神的造型——一个已经回到自身之中的外部，一个从自身出发并就自身本身把自己表现出来的内部；消解为思想，思想是一种生育着自身、并按自身保存着它的形态的明晰的定在。
精神就是艺术家。

en: Spirit has raised its shape, in which it is for its consciousness, into the form of consciousness itself, and brings forth such a one for itself.

The workmaster has given up the synthetic working, the mixing of the alien forms of thought and of the natural; since the shape has won the form of self-conscious activity, he has become a spiritual worker.
zh: 精神已经把它那种对它意识而言的形态，提升为意识本身的形式，并为自己产生出这样一个形态来。
工匠已经放弃了那种综合的工作，放弃了把思想与自然那些异己的形式混合起来的做法；既然形态已经赢得了自我意识活动的形式，他就成了精神的劳动者。

en: If we ask which is the actual spirit that has in the art-religion the consciousness of its absolute essence, then it turns out that it is the ethical or the true spirit.

It is not only the universal substance of all individuals, but, since it has for actual consciousness the shape of consciousness, this means as much as this: that it, which has its individualization, is known by them as their own essence and work.

Neither is it, for them, the being of light, in whose unity the being-for-itself of self-consciousness is contained only negatively, only as passing away, and beholds the lord of its actuality, nor is it the restless consumption of mutually hating peoples, nor the subjugation of the same into castes, which together make up the semblance of the organization of a completed whole, but one to which the universal freedom of the individuals is lacking.
Rather, it is the free people, in which custom makes up the substance of all, whose actuality and determinate being each and every individual knows as his own will and deed.
zh: 如果我们问，在艺术宗教中具有自己绝对本质的意识的那种现实的精神是哪一个，那么结果表明，它就是伦理的精神，或者说真的精神。
它不仅是所有个体的普遍实体，而且，既然它对于现实的意识具有意识的形态，这也就是说：它这个已经有了个体化的实体，被他们认作他们自己的本质和作品。
它对他们来说，既不是那种光明本质——在光明本质的统一中，自我意识的自为存在只是否定地、只是作为消逝者包含在内，并且直观着它现实性的主人——也不是那种彼此仇恨的民族的不停消耗，也不是把它们压成种姓；这些种姓合在一起构成了一个完成了的整体的组织的假象，但这个整体却缺少个体的普遍自由。
毋宁说，它就是自由的民族；在这个民族中，习俗构成所有人的实体，而每一个个体都知道它的现实性和定在就是自己的意志和行动。

en: The religion of the ethical spirit, however, is its elevation above its actuality, the going back out of its truth into the pure knowing of itself.

Since the ethical people lives in immediate unity with its substance and does not have in it the principle of the pure singleness of self-consciousness, its religion, in its completion, first appears in the parting from its existence.

For the actuality of the ethical substance rests partly on its tranquil immutability against the absolute movement of self-consciousness, and thereby on the fact that this has not yet gone out of its tranquil custom and its firm trust in itself, partly on its organization into a multitude of rights and duties, as well as into the distribution into the masses of the estates and their particular activity, which works together toward the whole — and thereby on the fact that the individual is content with the limitation of its determinate being and has not yet grasped the boundless thought of its free self.

But that tranquil, immediate trust in substance goes back into the trust in itself and into the certainty of itself; and the multitude of rights and duties, like the restricted activity, is the same dialectical movement of the ethical as the multitude of things and their determinations — a movement that finds its rest and firmness only in the simplicity of the spirit that is certain of itself.

— The completion of ethical life into free self-consciousness and the fate of the ethical world is therefore the individuality that has gone into itself, the absolute levity of the ethical spirit, which has dissolved all the fixed differences of its existence and the masses of its organic articulation into itself, and, completely certain of itself, has arrived at boundless joyfulness and the freest enjoyment of itself.
This simple certainty of spirit in itself is the ambiguous thing: to be tranquil subsistence and firm truth, as well as absolute unrest and the passing away of ethical life.

But it turns over into the latter, for the truth of the ethical spirit is as yet only this substantial essence and trust, in which the self does not know itself as free individuality, and which therefore perishes in this inwardness or in the becoming-free of the self.

Since, then, trust is broken and the substance of the people has caved in within itself, spirit, which was the middle of the extremes devoid of subsistence, has now stepped out into the extreme of the self-consciousness that comprehends itself as essence.
This is the spirit that is certain within itself, which mourns over the loss of its world and now brings forth its essence, raised above actuality, out of the purity of the self.
zh: 但是，伦理的精神的宗教，就是它对自己现实性的提升，就是从它的真理回到对它自身的纯粹知识。
既然伦理的民族在与其实体的直接统一中生活着，并且自我意识的纯粹个别性的原则不在它之中，那么它的宗教只有在它从自己的定在中告别时，才以完成形态出现。
因为伦理实体的现实性，一部分基于它针对自我意识的绝对运动的那种宁静的不变性，并由此而基于：自我意识还没有走出它宁静的习俗和它对自身的牢固信任；另一部分基于它组织为众多的权利与义务，并分配到等级的群体及其特殊的行动之中，这些行动协同作用，构成整体——并由此而基于：个体对它定在的界限感到满足，并且还没有把握住它那个自由自身的无界限的思想。
但是，那种对实体的宁静的、直接的信任，返回到对自身的信任和对自身的确定性之中；而众多的权利与义务，正如那种受限制的行动一样，就是伦理的同一个辩证运动，就像那些物及其规定的杂多一样——这个运动只在那个对自身确信的精神的单纯性中，才找到它的安宁和坚定。
——因此，伦理向自由的自我意识的完成，以及伦理的世界的命运，就是那个回到自身之中的个体性，就是伦理精神的绝对的轻浮；它已经把它定在的一切固定差别、以及它有机构成的群体，都消解在自身之中，并且完全地对自身确信地达到了无界限的欢悦和对自身最自由的享受。
精神在自身中的这种单纯的确定性，就是那个两可的东西：它既是宁静的持存和牢固的真理，又是绝对的不安和伦理的消逝。
但是它却转变为后者，因为伦理精神的真理暂时还只是这种实体的本质和信任，在这种本质和信任中，自我还不知道自己是自由的个体性，因而它就在这种内在性中、或者说在自我的自由化中灭亡了。
既然信任已经破碎、民族的实体已经在自身中塌陷，那么，那个原本是无持存的诸极端的中间的精神，现在就跨入了那个把自己把握为本质的自我意识的极端。
这就是那个在自身中确信的精神，它为它的世界的丧失而哀悼，并且如今从自我的纯粹性中，产生出它那个被提升到现实性之上的本质。

en: In such an epoch, absolute art steps forth; earlier it is the instinctive working, which, sunk into determinate being, works out of it and into it, does not have its substance in free ethical life, and therefore does not have, for the working self, free spiritual activity.

Later spirit is beyond art, in order to gain its higher representation — namely not only to be the substance born from the self, but, in its representation, to be the object of this self; not only to give birth to itself out of its concept, but to have its concept itself as shape, so that the concept and the produced artwork know each other as one and the same.
zh: 在这样的时代，绝对的艺术就登场了；在此以前，它是那种本能式的工作，这种工作沉浸于定在之中，从定在里向外工作、又向定在之中工作，它不在自由的伦理中有其实体，因而对那个工作着的自我来说，也不具有自由的精神活动。
后来，精神就超出了艺术，以便赢得它更高的表现——也就是说，它不仅是那种从自我产生出来的实体，而且在它的表现中就是这自我的对象；它不仅从自己的概念中生育自身，而且把自己的概念本身当作形态，这样，概念和被产生出来的艺术品就相互知道自己是同一个东西。

en: Since, then, the ethical substance has taken itself back out of its determinate being into its pure self-consciousness, this is the side of the concept, or of the activity, with which spirit produces itself as object.

It is pure form, because the individual, in ethical obedience and service, has worked off all unconscious determinate being and all fixed determinacy, just as the substance itself has become this fluid essence.

This form is the night in which substance was betrayed and made itself into subject; it is out of this night of the pure certainty of itself that the ethical spirit rises again as the shape freed from nature and from its immediate determinate being.
zh: 既然伦理实体已经从它的定在中返回到它纯粹的自我意识之中，那么这就是概念的方面，或者说活动的方面；精神凭借这种活动把自己作为对象产生出来。
它是纯粹的形式，因为个体在伦理的服从和服务中，已经把一切无意识的定在和固定的规定都消磨掉了，正如实体本身已经变成这种流动的本质。
这个形式就是那一夜，实体在其中被背弃，并把自己变成了主体；伦理精神正是从这自身纯粹确定性的那一夜里，作为摆脱了自然和它直接定在的形态而重新升起。

en: The existence of the pure concept, into which spirit has fled out of its body, is an individual that it has chosen for itself as the vessel of its pain.
He is present in this as its universal and its power, from which it suffers violence, as his pathos, to which being surrendered, its self-consciousness loses its freedom.
But that positive power of universality is vanquished by the pure self of the individual, as the negative power.

This pure activity, conscious of its power that cannot be lost, wrestles with the formless essence; having become master over it, it has made the pathos its stuff and given itself its content, and this unity steps forth as the work, the universal spirit individualized and represented.
zh: 纯粹概念的存在——精神从自己的身体中逃入其中——就是一个个体，是它为自己选来充当其痛苦的容器的。
他就在这个个体身上作为它的普遍东西和它的力量在场，它从这力量那里遭受暴力——他就是他的激情，委身于他的自我意识便失去了自由。
但普遍性的那种肯定的力量，被个体的纯粹自我作为否定的力量所征服。
这种纯粹的活动，意识到自己那不可丧失的力量，同无形态的本质搏斗；在成为它的主人之后，它把激情变成了自己的质料，并给予自身以内容；而这个统一就作为作品出现了，即被个体化并被表象出来的普遍精神。

39.en: a. The Abstract Work of Art

en: The first work of art, as the immediate one, is the abstract and single one.

On its side, it has to move out of the immediate and objective mode toward self-consciousness, just as, on the other hand, this, for itself in the cult, sets about sublating the distinction that it at first gives itself against its own spirit, and thereby bringing forth the work of art animated in itself.
zh: 第一件艺术作品，作为直接的东西，是抽象而单个的。
就其方面而言，它不得不从直接而对象性的方式中走出来，向自我意识迎面前进；正如另一方面，这个自我意识在崇拜中为自己着意去扬弃它最初针对自己的精神所作出的区分，并由此把在自身中活过来的艺术作品产生出来。

en: The first way in which the artistic spirit keeps its shape and its active consciousness farthest apart from each other is the immediate one, namely that the former is there as a thing in general.

– It falls apart within itself into the difference of individuality, which has the shape of the self in it, and of universality, which the inorganic essence constitutes in respect of the shape, as its environment and dwelling.
The latter gains, through the elevation of the whole into the pure concept, its pure form, the one belonging to spirit.

It is neither the intelligible crystal, which houses the dead or is shone upon by an external soul, nor the mixture of the forms of nature and of thought that first emerges from the plant, whose activity in this is still an imitation.

Rather, the concept strips off whatever still clings to the forms from root, boughs, and foliage, and purifies them into figures in which the straight-lined and flat features of the crystal are raised into incommensurable relations, so that the ensouling of the organic is taken up into the abstract form of the understanding, and at the same time its essence, incommensurability, is preserved for the understanding.
zh: 艺术精神把自己的形态同自己那活动的意识分得最开的这第一种方式，就是直接的方式，即前者作为一般的物而在场。
——它在自身中分解为个别性与普遍性的差别：前者在它身上具有自我的形态；后者则由无机的本质、就形态而言、作为它的环境和居所而构成。
后者通过把整体提升到纯粹概念之中，赢得了它那纯粹的、属于精神的形式。
它既不是那居藏死者、或者被一个外在的灵魂照亮的知性晶体，也不是那种最初从植物中产生出来的自然形式与思想形式的混合——思想在这里面的活动还只是模仿。
相反，概念把凡是还附着在形式上的根、枝、叶之类统统剥掉，并把它们净化为一些形象，晶体的直线性与平面性在其中被提升为不可通约的关系，从而使有机物的赋灵被接纳进知性的抽象形式，同时又为知性保住了它的本质，即不可通约性。

en: The indwelling god, however, is the black stone drawn out of the animal covering, which is penetrated with the light of consciousness.

The human shape strips off the animal shape with which it was mixed; the animal is for the god only a contingent disguise; it steps beside his true shape and counts for nothing in itself any more, but has sunk to being the meaning of an other, to a mere sign.

Thereby the shape of the god also strips off from itself the poverty of the natural conditions of animal existence, and indicates the inner arrangements of organic life as fused into its surface and belonging solely to this surface.
– The essence of the god, however, is the unity of the universal determinate being of nature and of self-conscious spirit, which in its actuality appears standing over against the former.
At the same time, at first a single shape, its determinate being is one of the elements of nature, just as its self-conscious actuality is a single national spirit.
But the former is, in this unity, the element reflected into spirit, the nature transfigured by thought and united with self-conscious life.
The shape of the god therefore has its nature-element in itself as a sublated one, as a dark recollection.

The wild essence and the confused struggle of the free determinate being of the elements, the un-ethical realm of the Titans, has been vanquished and banished to the margin of the actuality that has become clear, to the dim boundaries of the world that finds itself in spirit and is calmed.

These old gods, into which the light-being, begetting with darkness, at first particularizes itself — heaven, earth, the ocean, the sun, the blind typhonic fire of the earth, and so forth — have been replaced by shapes that have in them only the darkly recollecting echo of those Titans, and are no longer natural beings but clear ethical spirits of self-conscious peoples.
zh: 但那内住的神，则是从动物的外壳中抽出来的黑石，它被意识之光明所穿透。
人的形态把那种与它混在一起的动物形态剥掉；动物对神来说只是一种偶然的化装；它走到神的真实形态旁边，本身已经算不得什么，而是贬降为另一个东西的意义，贬降为单纯的符号。
神的形态也因此在自己身上同样剥掉了动物定在的那些自然条件的贫乏，并示意出：有机生命的内在构造已经融化在它的表面上，只隶属于这表面。
——但神的本质，则是自然的普遍定在与自我意识的精神的统一；后者在自己的现实性中，显现为同前者相对立。
它起初作为一种个别的形态，其定在就是自然的元素之一，正如它的自我意识的现实性就是一个个别的民族精神。
但前者在这个统一中，是那种反思到精神里去的元素，是被思想照亮了的、同自我意识的生命结合着的自然。
因此，神的形态在自己身上具有它的自然元素，那是作为一个被扬弃了的东西、作为一段幽暗的回忆而存在的。
元素的自由定在的那种荒蛮本质和混乱搏斗，那个非伦理的提坦王国，已经被战胜，并被赶到那变得清晰了的现实性的边缘，赶到那在精神中找到了自身、归于安宁的世界的昏暗边界上。
那些古老的神——光明本质最初与黑暗交合而生、从中分化出来的那些神，即天、地、海洋、太阳、地上那盲目的提丰之火，等等——已经被一些形态取代了；这些形态身上只还留着对那些提坦的幽暗回忆般的余响，并且不再是自然本质，而是自我意识的民族的清晰的伦理精神。

en: This simple shape has therefore annihilated within itself the restlessness of infinite individualization — both its own and that of the nature-element, which is necessary only as a universal essence but behaves contingently in its determinate being and movement, as well as its own as the people, which, dispersed into the particular masses of doing and into the individual points of self-consciousness, has a determinate being of manifold meaning and doing — and gathered it into tranquil individuality.

Opposite to it, therefore, stands the moment of restlessness — opposite to it, to the essence, stands self-consciousness, which, as the birthplace of that restlessness, retained for itself nothing but to be the pure activity.

What belongs to substance, the artist gave wholly to his work, but gave himself no actuality in the work as a determinate individuality; he could grant it perfection only by externalizing himself from his particularity, disembodying and elevating himself to the abstraction of pure doing.

– In this first immediate production, the separation of the work and its self-conscious activity is not yet again united; the work is therefore not for itself the actually ensouled one, but is a whole only together with its becoming.
The commonplace thing about the work of art, that it is produced in consciousness and made by human hands, is the moment of the concept existing as concept, which stands over against it.

And if this, as artist or beholder, is disinterested enough to declare the work of art absolutely ensouled in itself and to forget itself, the one doing or beholding, then against this the concept of spirit must be firmly held, which cannot dispense with the moment of being conscious of itself.

This moment, however, confronts the work, because in this its first diremption it gives both sides their abstract determinations of doing and thinghood over against each other, and their return into the unity from which they issued has not yet come to pass.
zh: 因此，这个单纯的形态已经在自身中消灭了无限个体化的不安——这不安既属于它自己，也属于那自然元素（自然元素只是作为普遍本质才必然，在它的定在和运动中却是偶然的）；同样，这不安也属于它自己作为民族（民族分散在行动的特殊群众和自我意识的个别点之中，具有一种意义和行动都纷杂不一的定在）——并把这种不安收拢为宁静的个体性。
因此，同它相对立的是不安的环节——同它、同这个本质相对立的是自我意识；自我意识作为这种不安的诞生地，除了是纯粹的活动之外，什么也没有给自己留下。
凡是属于实体的东西，艺术家都整个地给了他的作品；但他自己作为一种特定的个体性，在作品中却没有得到任何现实性；他只有通过对自己的特殊性加以外化、把自己脱去形体并提升到纯粹行动的抽象，才能赋予作品以完成。
——在这种最初的直接生产中，作品与它那自我意识的活动之间的分离还没有重新统一起来；因此，作品本身还不是那现实地获得了灵魂的东西，而只有连同它的生成过程才是一个整体。
艺术作品的寻常之处，即它是在意识中产生出来、由人手制造出来的，就是那个作为概念而存在的概念的环节，这个环节站在作品的对立面。
而如果这个环节，作为艺术家或观看者，竟然无私到宣称艺术作品在自身就是绝对被赋予灵魂的，并忘记自己这个行动者或观看者，那么与此相反，就必须紧紧把握住精神的概念，精神不能缺少对它自身有所意识这个环节。
然而，这个环节站在作品的对立面，因为它在这第一次的分裂中，把行动与物性的抽象规定分别给予双方、使它们彼此相对立，而它们向其所由之出发的那个统一的复归，还没有完成。

en: Thus the artist experiences in his work that he brought forth no essence equal to himself.
A consciousness does come back to him from it, to be sure, in such a way that an admiring crowd venerates it as the spirit that is their essence.
But this ensouling, in that it returns his self-consciousness to him only as admiration, is rather a confession that this ensouling makes to the artist, namely that it is not his peer.
Insofar as it comes back to him as cheerfulness in general, he finds in it neither the pain of his formation and begetting nor the exertion of his labor.

Let them also judge the work or bring offerings to it, in whatever way they put their consciousness into it — if they set themselves above it with their knowledge, he knows how much more his deed is than their understanding and talk; if they set themselves below it and recognize in it the essence that rules over them, he knows himself as the master of it.
zh: 因此，艺术家在他的作品上经验到：他没有产生出一个与他同等的本质。
固然有一个意识从作品那里回到他这里，以至于一群赞叹的人把它当作那作为他们本质的精神来崇敬。
但这种赋予灵魂，由于它只以赞叹回应他的自我意识，那就更是这种赋予灵魂向艺术家所作的自白，即它并不是他的同类。
当它作为一般的欢悦回到他这里时，他在其中找不到他教养与孕育的痛苦，也找不到他劳动的艰辛。
任凭他们也去评判这部作品或者向它献祭，无论他们以何种方式把自己的意识投入到里面，——如果他们凭自己的知识高踞其上，他就知道他的行为比他们的理解和言谈要多得多；如果他们自处于其下，并在其中认识到那支配着他们的本质，他就知道自己是这部作品的主人。

en: The work of art therefore requires another element of its determinate being, and the god another emergence than this one, in which he falls from the depth of his creative night into the opposite, into externality, into the determinacy of the thing devoid of self-consciousness.
This higher element is language — a determinate being that is immediately self-conscious existence.

As the individual self-consciousness is present in it, it is just as immediately a universal contagion; the complete particularization of being-for-itself is at the same time the fluidity and the universally communicated unity of the many selves; it is the soul existing as soul.

The god, therefore, who has language as the element of his shape, is the artwork ensouled in itself, which has immediately in its determinate being the pure activity that stood over against it as it existed as a thing.
Or, self-consciousness remains immediately with itself in the becoming-object of its essence.
Being thus with itself in its essence, it is pure thinking or devotion, whose inwardness has determinate being at the same time in the hymn.

It retains the individuality of self-consciousness within it, and this individuality is at the same time present as universal when heard; devotion, kindled in all, is the spiritual stream that, in the multiplicity of self-consciousness, is conscious of itself as an equal doing of all and as simple being; spirit has, as this universal self-consciousness of all, its pure inwardness just as much as being-for-others and the being-for-itself of the individuals in one unity.
zh: 因此，艺术作品要求它的定在具有另一个要素，神则要求另一个不同于此的产生过程；在这一个过程中，他从自己那创造之夜的深处坠入对立面、坠入外在性、坠入那没有自我意识的物的规定性。
这个更高的要素是语言，——一种定在，它直接地就是自我意识的存在。
个别的自我意识如何在它之中存在，它也就同样直接地是一种普遍的传染；自为存在的完全特殊化同时就是流动性和众多自我的普遍传达的统一；它就是那作为灵魂而存在的灵魂。
因此，把语言当作自己形态的要素的神，就是那在自身中获得了灵魂的艺术作品，它在自己的定在中直接地具有那种纯粹的活动——当初它作为物而存在时，这种活动是与它面对面的。
或者说，自我意识在自己的本质的对象化过程中直接地停留在自身。
它这样在自己的本质中与自身同在，就是纯粹的思维或虔诚，虔诚的内在性在颂歌中同时具有定在。
它在自身中保持着自我意识的个别性，而这种个别性在被听到的同时也是作为普遍的东西在场的；虔诚在所有人心中被点燃，它就是那精神的流，它在自我意识的多重性之中意识到自己是一切人同样的行动和单纯的存在；精神作为所有人的这种普遍的自我意识，在一种统一中同样地具有它的纯粹内在性、为他存在和各个个体的自为存在。

en: This language differs from another language of the god, which is not that of universal self-consciousness.

The oracle of the god of the art-religion as well as of the preceding religions is the necessary first language of the same; for in its concept lies just as much that it is the essence of nature as of spirit, and therefore has not only natural but also spiritual determinate being.
Insofar as this moment at first lies only in its concept and is not yet realized in religion, the language is for religious self-consciousness the language of a foreign self-consciousness.
The self-consciousness still alien to its congregation is not yet present in the way its concept demands.
The self is the simple and thereby absolutely universal being-for-itself; but that which is separated from the self-consciousness of the congregation is as yet only a single one.
– The content of this proper and individual language follows from the universal determinacy in which absolute spirit in general is posited in its religion.

– The universal spirit of the rising, which has not yet particularized its determinate being, therefore also utters simple and universal propositions about the essence, whose substantial content is exalted in its simple truth, but for the sake of this universality appears at the same time trivial to the self-consciousness that goes on forming itself.
zh: 这种语言不同于神的另一种语言，后者不是那普遍的自我意识的语言。
艺术宗教的神以及先前那些宗教的神，它们的神谕都是这同一位神的必然的第一语言；因为在它的概念中同样包含着：它就是自然的本质，也就是精神的本质，因此它不仅具有自然的定在，而且具有精神的定在。
因为这个环节最初还只寓于它的概念之中，还没有在宗教中实现，所以这种语言对于宗教的自我意识就是一个异己的自我意识的语言。
那还外在于它的教团的自我意识，还没有像它的概念所要求的那样在场。
自我是单纯的，并因而是绝对普遍的自为存在；但那与教团的自我意识相分离的东西，最初只是一个个别的。
——这种特有的而个别的语言的内容，是从那种普遍的规定性中产生出来的，绝对精神一般地在它的宗教中就是在这一规定性中被设定的。
——那升起的普遍精神，它还没有把自己的定在特殊化，因此也就说出关于本质的单纯而普遍的命题，这些命题的实质性内容在其单纯的真理中是崇高的，但正由于这种普遍性，它对那继续教养自身的自我意识同时显得平庸。

en: The further-formed self, which raises itself to being-for-itself, is master over the pure pathos of substance, over the objectivity of the rising being of light, and knows that simplicity of truth as the in-itself, which does not have the form of contingent determinate being through a foreign language, but as the sure and unwritten law of the gods, which lives eternally and of which no one knows whence it appeared.

– Just as the universal truth that was revealed by the being of light has here retreated back into the inner, or the lower, and is thereby removed from the form of contingent appearance, so, by contrast, in the art-religion, because the shape of the god has taken up consciousness and thereby individuality in general, the god's own language — the god who is the spirit of the ethical people — is the oracle, which knows the latter's particular affairs and announces what is useful about them.
Knowing thought, however, claims the universal truths for itself, because they are known as the in-itself, and their language is for it no longer a foreign one but its own.

Just as that sage of antiquity sought what is good and beautiful in his own thinking, but, on the other hand, left the bad contingent content of knowledge — whether it would be good for him to have dealings with this or that person, or for an acquaintance to make this journey, and such meaningless things — to the daemon to know, so too universal consciousness fetches the knowledge of the contingent from the birds, or from the trees, or from the fermenting earth, whose vapor takes composure away from self-consciousness; for the contingent is the uncomposed and the alien, and ethical consciousness therefore also lets itself be determined about it, as by a throw of the dice, in an uncomposed and alien manner.

When the individual determines himself through his understanding and with deliberation chooses what is useful to him, the determinacy of his particular character underlies this self-determination; it is itself the contingent, and that knowledge of the understanding of what is useful to the individual is therefore just such a knowledge as that of those oracles or of the lot; except that he who consults the oracle or the lot thereby expresses the ethical disposition of indifference toward the contingent, whereas that individual, on the other hand, treats what is in itself contingent as the essential interest of his thinking and knowing.

What is higher than both, however, is indeed to make deliberation the oracle of contingent doing, but to know this deliberated action itself, on account of its side of relation to the particular and of its usefulness, as something contingent.
zh: 那进一步教养出来的、把自己提升到自为存在的自我，是实体的纯粹激情的主人，是那升起的光明本质的对象性的主人，并且知道：那种真理的单纯性就是自在者，它并不凭着一种异己的语言而取得偶然的定在的形式，而是那可靠的、不成文的诸神法则——它永恒地活着，没有人知道它是从何而来的。
——正如那由光明本质启示出来的普遍真理，在这里已经退回到内部或下面，并由此摆脱了偶然的现象的形式；反之在艺术宗教中，由于神的形态已经把意识、因而把个别性一般地接纳于自身，那位作为伦理民族的精神的神，他自己的语言就是神谕，它知道这个民族的特殊事务，并把其中有益的东西宣告出来。
但是，知道的思维把那些普遍的真理争取为自己所有，因为它们作为自在者被认识，它们的语言对它来说就不再是异己的，而是自己的。

正如古代的那位智者在自己独有的思维中寻求什么是善的和美的，反过来却把知识中恶劣的、偶然的内容——与这个人还是那个人交往对他是否有好处，或某个熟人作这次旅行是否有好处，以及诸如此类毫无意义的事情——留给精灵去知晓；同样，普遍的意识也从鸟、从树、从那发酵的土地中取得关于偶然东西的知识，土地的蒸气夺走了自我意识的清醒；因为偶然的东西就是不清醒的东西和异己的东西，所以伦理的意识也就让自己如同通过掷骰子一样，以一种不清醒的、异己的方式就此得到规定。
如果个体通过自己的知性来规定自己，并经过考虑而选择那对他有用的东西，那么这种自我规定就是以特殊的性格的规定性为基础的；这种规定性本身就是偶然的，而知性关于什么对个体有用的那种知识，因此也就与那些神谕或拈阄的知识同样是这样的知识；只不过那求问神谕或拈阄的人，以此表达的是伦理的心态对偶然东西的漠然，而那一个体则相反，把自在的偶然之物当作自己思维和知识的本质兴趣。
但高于两者的做法，固然是把考虑变成偶然行动的神谕，但同时要知道：这个经过考虑的行动本身，鉴于它指向特殊东西的那一方面和它的有用性，乃是某种偶然的东西。

en: The true self-conscious determinate being, which spirit obtains in language, a language that is not that of an alien and hence contingent, non-universal self-consciousness, is the work of art that we saw earlier.
It stands over against the thing-character of the statue.

As the statue is the resting, so the work of art is the vanishing, determinate being; as in the statue objectivity, freely released, is devoid of its own immediate self, so conversely in the work of art it remains too much enclosed within the self, comes too little to shaping, and, like time, is immediately no longer there, in that it is there.
zh: 那真正的自我意识的定在——精神在语言中获得它，而这种语言不是那个陌生的、因而偶然的、非普遍的自我意识的语言——就是我们先前见过的艺术作品。
它同雕像的物性相对立。
正如雕像是那静止的定在，艺术作品则是那消逝着的定在；正如在雕像这里，对象性被自由地放开、不具有自己那直接的自我，反之在艺术作品那里，对象性又太过地被封闭在自我之中，很少达到成形，并且就像时间一样，正在场时便直接不再在场了。

en: The movement of both sides, in which the divine shape that moves in the pure feeling-element of self-consciousness and the divine shape that rests in the element of thinghood mutually surrender their different determinations, and the unity, which is the concept of their essence, comes to determinate being, is what constitutes the cult.

In it, the self gives itself the consciousness of the descent of the divine essence from its beyond to it; and this essence, which previously was the unreal and merely objective, thereby receives the proper actuality of self-consciousness.
zh: 这两个方面的运动——在其中，那在自我意识的纯粹感受元素中运动着的、和那在物性元素中静止着的神的形态，互相放弃它们不同的规定，而那个作为它们本质的概念的统一就来到定在——就构成了崇拜。
在崇拜中，自我给予自身以这样一种意识：神圣本质正从它的彼岸性降落到自我这里；而这个本质，它以前是非现实的东西、仅仅是对象性的东西，并由此获得了自我意识的真正的现实性。

en: This concept of the cult is already in itself contained and present in the stream of the hymn.
This devotion is the immediate pure satisfaction of the self through and within itself.
It is the purified soul, which in this purity is immediately only essence, and one with the essence.
On account of its abstraction, it is not the consciousness that distinguishes its object from itself, and is therefore only the night of its determinate being and the prepared site of its shape.
The abstract cult therefore raises the self to be this pure divine element.

The soul accomplishes this purification consciously; but it is not yet the self that has descended into its depths and knows itself as evil; rather it is a being, a soul, which purifies its externality with washing, clothes it in white garments, and carries its inwardness all the way through the represented path of labors, punishments, and rewards, the path of the formation that externalizes particularity in general, through which it arrives at the dwellings and the community of bliss.
zh: 崇拜的这个概念，自在说来就已经包含在颂歌的洪流之中、就已经在场了。
这种虔诚，是自我通过自身、在自身之中获得的直接的纯粹的满足。
它是那被净化了的灵魂；灵魂在这种纯洁中直接地只是本质，并且与本质合一。
正因为它这种抽象，它还还不是那种把自己的对象同自己区分开来的意识，因而只是那对象的定在的黑夜，只是它的形态的预先备好的场所。
因此，抽象的崇拜把自我提升到去成为这个纯粹的神圣元素。
灵魂是有意识地完成这种净化的；但它还还不是那个曾下沉到自己最深处、知道自己就是恶的自我；不如说它只是一个存在者，一个灵魂：它用洗涤来净化自己的外部性，给自己穿上白衣，并且让自己的内在性一路走完那条被表象出来的劳作、惩罚与奖赏之路，即那条把特殊性外化出去的教养之路——经由这条路，它才抵达那些居所和至福的共同体。

en: This cult is at first only a secret, that is, a merely represented, unreal accomplishment; it must be actual action, for an unreal action contradicts itself.
The proper consciousness thereby raises itself into its pure self-consciousness.

The essence has in it the meaning of a free object; through the actual cult this object returns into the self; and insofar as it has in pure consciousness the meaning of the pure essence dwelling beyond actuality, this essence descends through this mediation from its universality to individuality, and thus closes with actuality.
zh: 这种崇拜起初还只是一种隐秘的完成，即一种仅仅被表象出来的、非现实的完成；它必须是现实的行动，因为非现实的行动会自相矛盾。
真正的意识由此而提升到它的纯粹的自我意识。
本质在它那里具有一个自由对象的意义；通过现实的崇拜，这个对象又返回到自我之中，——并且，就它在纯粹意识中具有那个纯粹的、居住在现实性彼岸的本质的意义而言，这个本质便通过这种中介从它的普遍性下降到个别性，并就这样同现实性结合在一起。

en: How both sides enter into the action is determined thus: for the self-conscious side, insofar as it is actual consciousness, the essence presents itself as actual nature; on the one hand, nature belongs to it as possession and property and counts as the determinate being that is not in-itself; on the other hand, it is the essence's own immediate actuality and individuality, which is by the essence likewise regarded as non-essence and sublated.

At the same time, however, for its pure consciousness that external nature has the opposite meaning, namely that of being the essence that is in itself, against which the self sacrifices its unessentiality, just as, conversely, the unessential side of nature sacrifices itself.

The action is thereby spiritual movement, because it is this double-sidedness: to sublate the abstraction of the essence, as devotion determines the object, and to make it actual; and to sublate the actual, as the agent determines the object and itself, and to raise it into universality.
zh: 两个方面如何进入行动，其规定是这样的：对于自我意识这一方面，只要它是现实的意识，本质就把自己表现为现实的自然；一方面，自然是作为占有物和财产隶属于本质的，并且被算作那没有自在存在的定在；另一方面，它又是本质自己的直接的现实性和个别性，同样被本质看作非本质的东西并加以扬弃。
但同时，对于本质的纯粹意识，那个外在的自然却具有相反的意义，即它是那自在存在着的本质，自我对着它献出自己的非本质性；正如反过来，自然那非本质的一面也把它自身献出去。
行动由此而是精神的运动，因为它就是这种双面性：把本质的抽象——正如虔诚规定对象那样——扬弃掉，并使之成为现实的东西；又把现实的东西——正如行动者规定对象和自己那样——扬弃掉，并把它提升到普遍性之中。

en: The action of the cult itself therefore begins with the pure surrender of a possession, which the owner seemingly pours out for it as entirely useless, or lets ascend in smoke.

In this, before the essence of his pure consciousness, he renounces possession and the right of property and of the enjoyment of it, personality, and the return of doing into the self; and he reflects the action rather into the universal, or into the essence, than into himself.
Conversely, however, the existent essence likewise perishes therein.

The animal that is sacrificed is the sign of a god; the fruits that are consumed are the living Ceres and Bacchus themselves; in the former die the powers of the upper right, which has blood and actual life; in the latter, however, the powers of the lower right, which bloodlessly possesses the secret, cunning power.
The sacrifice of the divine substance belongs, insofar as it is a doing, to the self-conscious side; for this actual doing to be possible, the essence must already have sacrificed itself in itself.
It has done this in that it has given itself determinate being and made itself into the individual animal and into the fruit.

This renunciation, which the essence has thus already accomplished in itself, the acting self represents in determinate being and for its consciousness, and it replaces that immediate actuality of the essence with the higher one, namely with its own.
For the unity that has arisen, which is the result of the sublated individuality and separation of both sides, is not merely negative fate, but has positive significance.

Only to the abstract subterranean essence is what is sacrificed to it wholly surrendered, and thereby the reflection of possession and of being-for-self into the universal, distinct from the self as such, is signified.

At the same time, however, this is only a small part; the other sacrificing is merely the destruction of the unusable and rather the preparation of the sacrificed for the meal, whose feast cheats the action out of its negative meaning.
In that first sacrifice the one sacrificing keeps the greatest part, and from the second he reserves what is usable for his enjoyment.

This enjoyment is the negative power that sublates the essence as well as individuality, and at the same time it is the positive actuality in which the objective determinate being of the essence is transformed into a self-conscious one, and the self has the consciousness of its unity with the essence.
zh: 因此，崇拜自身的行动，是从纯粹地交出一份财产开始的；所有者仿佛全然无用地为它倾倒这份财产，或者让它化作青烟升腾。
他这是在纯粹意识的本质面前，放弃占有，放弃财产权和对它的享用权，放弃人格，放弃行动向自我的复归；并且他把这行动反思进普遍的东西、或者说反思进本质，而不是反思进自身。
——但反过来，那存在着的本质也同样就此灭亡。
被献祭的动物，是一位神的符号；被吃掉的水果，就是活生生的刻瑞斯与巴库斯本身，——在前者中死去的是上界法权的诸力量，上界法权拥有血与现实的生命；在后者中死去的则是下界法权的诸力量，下界法权无血地拥有那种隐秘的、狡诈的力量。
——对神圣实体的献祭，就其是行动而言，属于自我意识这一方面；这种现实的行动之所以可能，本质必须已经自在地把自身献出去了。
它已经这样做了：它给予自身以定在，并把自己造成个别的动物、造成果实。
这种放弃——本质已经自在地把它完成了——由行动着的自我在定在中、为它的意识表现出来，并用更高的现实性、即自我自己的现实性，替换掉本质的那直接的现实性。
因为那产生了的统一——它是被扬弃了的个别性和两个方面的分离的结果——并不只是否定的命运，而是具有积极的意义。
只有对那个抽象的地下界的本质，献祭给它的东西才被整个地交出去，并由此表明：财产和自为存在反思进那个普遍的东西，而这个普遍东西是同作为这样的自我区别开来的。
但同时，这只是很小的一部分；另一半的献祭，只是把没用的东西毁掉，毋宁说是把献祭的东西准备成宴席；这场宴饮哄骗着行动，把它的否定意义骗掉了。
在那第一种献祭中，献祭者把绝大部分留给自己；对第二种献祭，他把有用的部分留着供自己享用。
这种享用是否定的力量，它把本质连同个别性一起扬弃；同时它又是积极的现实性，在它之中，本质的对象性的定在被转变成了自我意识的定在，自我便具有对自己与本质之统一的意识。

en: This cult is, to be sure, an actual action, but its meaning lies mostly only in devotion; what belongs to devotion is not brought forth as an object, just as the result in enjoyment deprives itself of its own determinate being.

The cult therefore goes further and makes up for this deficiency, in the first instance, by giving its devotion an objective subsistence, since it is the common or individual work that is possible for each, which brings forth the dwelling and the adornment of the god in his honor.

Thereby, in part, the objectivity of the statue is sublated, for through this consecration of his gifts and works the worker makes the god favorable to himself and beholds his self as belonging to him; in part, this doing is not the individual working of the artist, but this particularity is dissolved in universality.

But it is not only the honor of the god that comes into being, and the blessing of his favor does not flow only in representation toward the worker; rather, the work also has the opposite meaning as against the first, that of externalization and of alien honor.

The dwellings and halls of the god are for the use of man; the treasures that are kept within them are, in case of need, his own; the honor that the former enjoys in his splendor is the honor of the skillful and magnanimous people.
At the festival, this people likewise decorates its own dwellings and garments as well as its doings with graceful implements.

In this way it receives, for its gifts, the requital from the grateful god and the proofs of his favor, in which it bound itself to him through work, not in hope and in a deferred actuality, but has immediately, in the show of honor and the presentation of gifts, the enjoyment of its own wealth and adornment.
zh: 这个崇拜固然是一种现实的行为，它的意义却更多地只在于虔诚；凡属于虔诚的东西，都不是对象性地产生出来的，正如享受中的结果自己剥夺了自己的定在。
因此，崇拜继续走下去，首先以下面这一点弥补这个缺陷：它给自己的虔诚一个对象性的持存，因为它就是那种共同的或单个的、每个人都能胜任的劳动，这种劳动为了敬奉神而造出神的居所和妆饰。
——由此，一方面是雕像的对象性被扬弃了，因为劳动者通过这种对自己的礼物和劳作的奉献，使神对自己垂青，并看到自己的自我是属于神的；另一方面，这种行动也不是艺术家的个体创作，而是这种特殊性消解在普遍性之中。
但是，成就出来的不只是神的荣耀，神的眷顾所赐的福也不只是在表象中流向劳动者；相反，劳动还具有与那第一种意义相反的意义，即外化和异己的荣耀的意义。
神的居所和殿堂是供人使用的；那些保藏在里面的珍宝，在急需时就是人自己的；神在自己的华饰中所享受的那份荣耀，就是有技艺而又宽宏的民族的荣耀。
在节日里，这个民族同样用精美的器物装饰自己的住所、衣着和自己的各项活动。
它就这样为自己的礼物而从感恩的神那里领受回报，领受他的眷顾的证明——它就是通过劳动、在这种眷顾中与神结合起来的——这不是在希望中和一种以后的现实性里，而是在致敬和献礼之中，直接享受到自己的财富和妆饰。
